title: The project garden gets two new entries
summary:
A quiet garden day: two community projects added, with some text-model plumbing kept current behind the hedge.

Rizqi O Chatbot and KoboldAI were added to the community project list, making two more things built with Pollinations easier to find.

The available-models registry and Portkey text-generation path were updated, keeping the text API's model map and routing machinery in step.
